about_short_description.short_description: Swipe Technologies is a company that specialises in business-time office automation systems and fingerprint technologies.

product.name: Physical Access Control System
product.description: A system that manages and regulates employee and group access to doors and premises, supporting multiple access rules and real-time monitoring.

product.name: Time & Attendance System
product.description: A system that tracks real-time employee attendance and movement data on a unified platform to manage workforce presence.

product.name: Visitor Management System
product.description: An automated system to monitor, capture, and manage visitor information and access within premises, including pre-registration and verification.

product.name: CCTV Surveillance System
product.description: A range of surveillance cameras from analog to IP types providing video monitoring solutions for various industries.

product.name: Fire Alarm System
product.description: An intelligent fire detection and alarm system designed to detect fire incidents and alert occupants across various building types.

product.name: Fire Hydrant System
product.description: A fire fighting system that uses pumps and hydrants to increase fire fighting capacity in buildings, commonly used in residential and industrial projects.
